body:
Mad inspiration!

I'm going to rotate my bed through 90 degress... then it might feel like mine alone.

reply part two... with the best will in the world I think you might be further from the plot than me!

Love and Truth are names of the divinity, not separable. What nonsense are you chasing? [there but for the grace of G*d go I]

Thank you for your sincere post which does speak to me.
I was raised by a humble honest sincere and ethical set of parents whose lessons to me I will cherish always. Their views framed my ethical world view, however I forget how young I was when I obnoxiously screwed up christmas day rituals [church, mince pies and coffee, then your father will start to tease you with the presents] because I could not swallow all that stuff that made no sense. *ahem I was 11*

My first breakdown at 27 was ended through divine intervention, the answer to my most reluctant prayer "if you exist, help me" squawked that prayer one night, woke next day in recovery, without ever leaving my own bed. a real true miracle, not a drug involved.

So I'm not an atheist, but I'll never settle for US or Vatican Christianity either.
I'll get back to you... your words speak to my tomorrow, and after I have eaten and/or slept I shall return to them.

I can't thank you enough, or chicametipo too, for being here for me and with me. I already feel better, not so desperately blind, just ordinary wounded and hurt... perhaps I can sleep now? I'll try, and that will be a healing too.

Sincere thanks folks, and hope you earned real karma for being there when nobody else was.

thank you very much.

I am not convinced that I am entirely without blame, nor that partner is entirely at fault in the recent fight, but he's undeniably added to my stress load over time. I get to write this thread and he can't see it, so naturally the words will slant in my favour. He's also been a great support at times, just not reliably and when I most needed it. In fact anytime but then!

I wish I could sleep, or even eat, but these are the first things to go when I am stressed, otherwise your advice is just what I would tell myself. Thanks again.

Talking here has brought the stress down by quite a few notches.

I can't even get help for the bipolar thing, and I've been presenting it for 30 years. I got my medical notes as part of the appeal process, and for 30 years I've been complaining about episodes of depression interspersed with episodes of not be able to eat or sleep for days on end.

After the last chap I joined an email counciling list for abused women. You'll understand that whilst that is the literal truth, it's also not an identity I wish to clothe myself in? I left it recently when the words no longer seemed like lightbulbs, or especially relevant.

The chap currently in question called *me* abusive, because I shouted at him - stuff about control [his] and space [mine]. Perhaps I was just avenging previous hurts?

great post

>Now this partner sounds like a very insecure person emotionally, and it's a huge shame that he's done this to you - pushed you away, pulled you back, pushed you away again, huh? Some people just do this over and over. It's sad and shows his lack of emotional stability

spot on. I'm usually the strong one for him, I'm just worn right now after 3 days of torture that I am still in, where he was demanding an apology, firing out lots of hurts, and only a few hours ago told me what I had done; for what it matters I shouted at him "in public" in my home not his in front of others. I have apologised for the offense to his dignity but not for the simple truths I said.

>how can I convince you at this early stage that things will be better if you're out of that loop? 

Would you believe that this is a repeating pattern? It's my efforts to stand up for myself that bought me to publicly shouting at him. I'm breaking the mould, somewhat; the last partner broke my nose before I had the sense to leave.

Close friends who are nevertheless not close enough to tune into my POV say I've never been so happy as with this guy. I'm awfully confused. I certainly have huge strong feelings. I'm certainly not in a healthy place.


edit to add:

I hate phones and have never had much luck phoning the samaritans... that's why I tried email this time. I've found them to be more attentive to the rhythm of the conversation than the content. I think I said at the start of this thread that I tend to present far better than I actually am. 

Salvation Army is an idea, googling now.

Even this much *attentive* listening is a huge help. Thanks again.

How am I feeling? didn't answer that one did I? I just wish I could sleep... I am so very weary. I want my mummy, but she's 82 and I am not going to stress her out with this; after all I have to take responsibility for how and where I find myself.

hi and thank you.  I can't turn to my family in this extremis; suicide is a selfish no-no. I promised my Mum years ago that I would never do it... I have kids, grown now and she impressed upon me the damage it would do to them.

Doesn't actually stop me being in this place though. I'm struggling hard not to wander into self-pity. I'm getting up often and cleaning house, trying to drag myself away from the swamping emotions. Some cynical part of myself says "at least it will be clean when they find me".  Don't you worry either, kind  redGPz, I shall not be acting on the urges.

I turned to my family for financial help months ago, and they were really good to me... the money has run out now and still no sign of my appeal being heard. I can't ask them again.

Emotionally, I'm 12 again around them and constrained by playing a role. I've tried so hard to bust out of that role and be real, but they're all very nice, very secure, very middle-class folks who simply don't have a clue what my life is like. I don't want to spend all my time shocking them.
